messages: maya: Starting a coordinated docs migration this afternoon. Plan: rename /guides -> /reference/guides, then split heavy auth and deploy pages into includes. Will open multiple PRs and want an explicit merge order to avoid broken anchors and noisy CI. devon: Sounds good. Can you enumerate the PRs and the intended order? I can watch previews and run the link smoke. maya: Opening these: PR #8430 (redirect-map + smoke CI job), PR #8431 (move guides index + landing stubs), PR #8432 (split auth & deploy pages), PR #8433 (examples and SDK snippet updates). My preferred order: 8430 -> 8431 -> 8432 -> 8433. li: Why 8430 first? Wouldn't splitting first give a more correct redirect map? maya: Two reasons: 1) 8430 is tiny and provides a safety net (redirects) so previews don't 404 flood; 2) adding the smoke CI job in 8430 means any following PR will fail fast if we break a link. anu: I'm +1 to making the smallest change first. Also, let's be careful with CDN cache TTLs for redirects. I'll open INFRA-1301 to coordinate cache headers. devon: Can we include a simple smoke script in 8430? Something like `yarn docs:build && node scripts/check-redirects.js`. The script should follow 3xx up to 5 hops and report mismatched anchors. maya: Yes. Example snippet for check-redirects.js: ```js const fetch = require('node-fetch'); async function resolve(u){ const r = await fetch(u,{redirect:'manual'}); if(r.status>=300 && r.status<400){ return r.headers.get('location'); } return null; } // iterate sitemap urls and assert 200 or valid redirect ``` li: Add retry logic (3 tries, exponential backoff) for flaky preview network. We had intermittent 502s last month that caused false negatives. maya: Will add retries. Also making 8430 add a small testfile mapping anchors -> destinations for common external links. devon: I'll grep repo for `import { Client } from '@redwood/sdk'` and other snippets. If snippet paths change, 8433 will need to update many includes. Might be good to preserve alias includes for one release. anu: For translation teams: moving files will change localization keys. Maya, please put a list of moved files in each PR description and tag @localization so they can re-run imports. maya: Done. Also adding a short migration note to the old index path in 8431 (meta-refresh + link) so external crawlers land on a page that points to the new structure instead of a blank 404. docs-bot: [preview-posted] PR 8430 preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8430/ :white_check_mark: devon: 8430 preview link looks good. Running smoke script locally now. docs-bot: [merge] PR 8430 merged by devon at 1769603056 :tada: devon: 8430 merged. CI on main shows the new smoke job passing. Proceeding to rebase 8431 on main and will update Netlify preview. maya: Heads up: 8431 will include redirect landing pages for a handful of well-known anchors (auth, oauth, jwt). That should prevent external links from breaking SEO. li: I'll be available to run a manual link-check after 8431 merges. Also I'll coordinate with infra about lowering CDN TTLs for the rollout window so we can flip back if needed. anu: INFRA-1301 updated: temporary TTLs and a canary rule for /reference/guides/* during the migration. Linking in PRs. devon: Reviewing 8431. Found one edge where `guides/advanced/caching.md` had an internal anchor `#kv-cache` referenced from multiple places. After the move, anchor URL will be `/reference/guides/advanced/caching#kv-cache` but some old links include `#kvcache` (no hyphen). Can we add alias anchors in 8431 to cover both? maya: I'll add alias anchors using HTML `` in the new files so both versions work. Good catch. docs-bot: [merge] PR 8431 merged by devon at 1769603856 :white_check_mark: devon: 8431 merged and Netlify preview of main looks stable. No widespread 404s. maya: Opening 8432 now (content split). This will be the most review-heavy PR. Requesting reviews from li and devon. li: I'll prioritize 8432. For splits, please make sure each new fragment has a frontmatter slug that matches the redirect map so previews render correctly. devon: Also keep the examples include path stable. If 8432 moves an example file, 8433 should update snippets but we prefer staged edits: split first, then examples. maya: Agreed. 8432 is WIP and I'll push small commits. Expect lots of tiny PR comments (includes, relative path fixes, anchor IDs). docs-bot: [preview-posted] PR 8432 preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8432/ :white_check_mark: li: Reviewing 8432 now. Found two missing include paths in the deploy docs. Pushing a suggestion commit. devon: After 8432 merges, I'll run a full grep for `@redwood/sdk` and update 8433 with snippet path changes. For backward compatibility I'll add a short include that contains the old import lines and is conditionally used by a compatibility flag we set for one release. maya: Good idea. Also adding a short migration guide doc in 8433 that lists changed URLs and common anchor mappings for customers to update bookmarks. docs-bot: [merge] PR 8432 merged by li at 1769605256 :tada: li: 8432 merged. Running final smoke check now. devon: Smoke check passed. No unresolved 404s surfaced. I'll start preparing 8433 updates for snippets. anu: Reminder: update the sitemap in 8430 mapping when all moves are final so search engines pick up new paths. maya: Will do as part of 8433 cleanup. Final plan: merge 8433 tomorrow morning to give CDN TTLs a full day to propagate and let localization team re-import. devon: Sounds safe. Thanks everyone for the careful sequencing. maya: Posting a short summary to #announcements after 8433 merges. If something goes sideways we have quick rollback steps in the 8431 PR description. :rocket:
